class-status-effects.json.status: Class content extensions authored in TASK-003–008; additive policies unchanged.

combat-rules.json.status: M0 baseline authored for this game; not reverse engineered reference formulas

units.rounding_hp_damage: floor(max(0,value)+1e-9) once after mitigation and before shields
units.non_finite_or_unsafe_numeric_result: diagnostic failure, never silently clamp buffs

primary_milestone_bonus.basis: final primary value after equipment/enchant/status modifiers; steps = floor(value/10)
primary_milestone_bonus.source: D-057; assistant baseline to tune in TASK-041. Never adds attack_speed or cast_speed so manual AGI/DEX timing stays the only rotation lever.

rotation.normal_during_CT: pause_clock_preserve_remaining; no hits queued as catch-up
rotation.interrupt: invalidate_cast_token; start_ACD_at_interrupt_time then SI; both advance during_CC

snapshots.caster_offense: cast_start; includes resolved_skill and pre_spend_SP for named formulas
snapshots.event_target_binding: fixed event actor; dead target is not retargeted

event_order.time_domain: integer ms and explicit sequence; independent of renderer FPS
event_order.cast_completion_batch: locked completers emit even if killed/interrupted by another locked completer; HP0 is ineligible for ordinary heal; death reactions/cleanup commit at phase barrier
event_order.zero_CT: start-and-resolve in ready-skill phase; still spends_SP/slot and suppresses coincident_normal
event_order.root_program_reactions: enqueue_during_program; drain_at_phase_boundary, not JS callback order
event_order.initial_tie_breaker: stable actor_id, action_id, effect_order, target_id, hit_index, event_sequence
event_order.target_liveness: HP > 0 for normal targeting/healing; locked caster admission is retained only for the admitted completion program

rng.order: target_selection_if_random -> hit -> eligible_crit -> effect_chance per ordered_effect/target/hit

simulation_contract.reference_balance: M0 arithmetic sensitivity, M1 runtime_parity, M4 measured_balance

damage_redirect.stage: after rounded mitigation before target shields
damage_redirect.eligibility: live other actor on same team only; source_death removes link
damage_redirect.aggregation: sum independent fractions without cap; conserve original damage, proportional allocation if total fraction exceeds one
damage_redirect.allocation: total=min(P,floor(P*sumRatio)); floor proportional shares, distribute remaining points by instance ID; one routing pass
damage_redirect.transfer: recipient shields then HP; no second armor/crit/guard; origin transfer cannot redirect/reflect/proc unless a trigger explicitly accepts it
damage_redirect.attribution: original attacker/action plus redirecting status source; no damage creation

element_chart_reference.title: Ragnarok Origin
element_chart_reference.source: In-game Elemental Effectiveness screenshot embedded in the ROO Global guide, written by Mumei #4529 from ROO Discord Tavern
element_chart_reference.source_percentages: bonus relative to 100%; dot means zero bonus, not zero damage
element_chart_reference.scope: One10x10table, no elemental levels. This adopts the chart only, not ROO skill elements, armor cards, conversions, stats or whole-game formulas. Current server variants are not claimed identical.

effects.result: pay caster HP once per effect/root at resolve then emit ordinary physical/magical damage; never self-kill or refund SP; no incoming-damage proc

handler_registry.contract: select matching status instances on target with same source actor; select expiry then application_id up to max_consumed; consume exactly selected instances; emit flat raw power=count*power_per_instance through normal damage pipeline; snapshot consumed count once; cannot consume unrelated poison

effect-primitives.json.modifier_source: runtime attaches immutable source_instance_id; definitions cannot choose another owner source

proc_guard.limit_reached: diagnostic failure, never silently truncate buff stacks

effect-primitives.json.snapshot: caster offense and pre-cost resources at cast start; status carries application offense snapshot; defense live per hit
effect-primitives.json.special_effect_lifecycle: shield independent pools; summoned actors not roster members and do not prevent party defeat; revive restarts next unspent SI, no refund or replay of spent slot

special_contracts_d169.selector: highest max(P.ATK,M.ATK), optional exclude_self/actor_kind; actor_id ties
special_contracts_d169.parameter_formulas: registry-only nonnegative snapshot raw power to declared numeric status params; no JS evaluation
special_contracts_d169.damage_charge: oldest eligible charge per resolved damaging skill, whole root action; normals/periodic/proc do not consume
special_contracts_d169.skill_echo: descending tier conditional roll once per instance/root; add extra repeat counts between independent applications; Bolt whitelist only
special_contracts_d169.magic_critical: optional cast and periodic status snapshot flag, absent false
special_contracts_d169.visual_link: presentation color from live status source to recipient
